issues.description: Person.firstName has different visibility between template and solution. Template declares it as a private field (`private String firstName;`), while the solution declares it as public (`public String firstName;`). This breaks consistency in the intended encapsulation style (all other fields remain private with getters/setters) and can confuse students comparing their code to the reference.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution to match the template by making `firstName` private (`private String firstName;`) and keep access via `getFirstName()` / `setFirstName()`.

issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to adapt a deployment build script named `build.sh` or `build.bat`, but neither file exists in the provided template (and consequently not in the solution). This makes the required task unlocatable and blocks students from following the instructions without guessing where to place the commands.
issues.suggestedFix: Add the referenced script file(s) (`build.sh` and/or `build.bat`) to the template repository (and solution, if needed) with appropriate placeholders, or update the problem statement to reference the actual script filename(s) present in the repository.
